name: Kozilek
description: Kozilek is one of the three Eldrazi titans of Zendikar, remembered by the merfolk as the trickster god Cosi.

description_citations.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.
"Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

summary.text: Kozilek is one of the three Eldrazi titans of Zendikar, remembered by the merfolk as the trickster god Cosi.

bio.text: Kozilek arrived on Zendikar with Ulamog and Emrakul and was petrified with them over Akoum.

citations.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.
"The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

bio.text: Ob Nixilis called Kozilek up from beneath Zendikar.

"Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

bio.text: At Sea Gate he ripped open the sea wall and split Lorthos with his obsidian blades, and Kiora realized she had been tricked.

citations.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.
"The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

bio.text: He freed his brother Ulamog, and a wave from him killed and warped fleeing Zendikari soldiers, while Tazri's visions showed him killing Gideon and resurrecting him for amusement.

citations.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citations.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

bio.text: Kiora concluded that Kozilek was a distortion phenomenon from the Blind Eternities and not a god.

citations.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

bio.text: Nissa wove Zendikar's leylines into a glyph that bound the titans, and Chandra's fire along the leylines destroyed them.

citations.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

status.text: Kozilek was destroyed in a blinding blast near Sea Gate by Chandra's fire along the leylines.

citations.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.
"Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds a carving of herself with a Kozilek-like figure named 'Nahiri the Prophet, Voice of Talib', and collapses the building, blaming herself for calling Kozilek a god.
timeline.quote: "Nahiri the Prophet, Voice of Talib."

citation.text: "Stirring from Slumber" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon attacks the trapped Ulamog, but Ob Nixilis calls Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, leaving two titans rampaging.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis had called Kozilek, one of the other Eldrazi titans, from beneath Zendikar's surface.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kozilek rises from the bay and rips open the sea wall, letting the Halimar Sea pour through.
timeline.quote: Another and he stood before Sea Gate.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora realizes Cosi always won and that she has been tricked, as Kozilek turns toward her.
timeline.quote: Cosi always won.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kozilek takes control of Shen, who lunges at Kiora, and she kills him with the bident.
timeline.quote: She raised the bident, and its twin points buried themselves in Shen's chest.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kozilek cleaves Lorthos in two, and Kiora falls into the water and drops the bident.
timeline.quote: Lorthos's body shuddered and split

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora realizes Kozilek never saw her and that she has killed her followers, then loses consciousness.
timeline.quote: She hit the water, and blackness claimed her.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis calls a second titan, Kozilek, up from the ground.
timeline.quote: The demon had called yet another horror to ravage her world.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa surrenders to rage and runs at the demon through Kozilek's distortion and the toppling lighthouse.
timeline.quote: Kozilek's flailing arm had smashed into the seawall

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Kozilek rises, Ulamog is freed, and Tazri rallies her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Tazri rallied her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: A shimmering wave from Kozilek crashes over the fleeing army, killing Romoe, Magain and Debins horribly.
timeline.quote: Time slowed. Insanity blossomed.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The wave hits Tazri and her angel's halo glows as her past and future flicker through her mind.
timeline.quote: Time, previously slowed, now stretched .

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Kozilek repeatedly resurrects and kills Gideon for amusement.
timeline.quote: Another twitch, another ripple , and Gideon Jura was reborn again

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: after Kozilek leaves, Tazri spends ten thousand years trying to recreate Zendikar, and then billions of years in sleep waiting for him.
timeline.quote: For the first ten thousand years after Kozilek's disappearance, Tazri had used her new powers to attempt the reconstruction.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri returns to find her soldiers dead and Kozilek far away, and sees Noyan Dar's roilmages obliterated by reflected fire and earth.
timeline.quote: Tazri didn't have time to shout a warning as the fire and earth swept through the roilmages, obliterating them.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra searches the battlefield for Gideon and Jace while two titans wander the land and a swarm approaches.
timeline.quote: Too many to take on by herself.

citation.text: "Up in Flames" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori breaks the surface and sees Sea Gate toppled and eroded by Kozilek's blight, remembering that Ulamog was freed and Kozilek rose.
timeline.quote: The hedron network had failed. Ulamog was free.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: In Kozilek's reshaped caves, Kiora senses the bident beyond a ravine.
timeline.quote: The bident is that way,

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: From the mountains Gideon sees the ruin of Sea Gate and the two titans creeping across the land, and realizes his army is gone.
timeline.quote: His army was gone.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra leads the group that baits Ulamog, while Gideon leads the other bait army toward Kozilek, toward Jace and Nissa waiting in the titans' path.
timeline.quote: The plan involved being as noticeably, tantalizingly alive as possible

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kiora realizes the titan Kozilek is a distortion phenomenon from the Blind Eternities, not a god.
timeline.quote: Not a trickster, but a trick.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa lights with magic and weaves Zendikar's leylines into a tripartite glyph that lashes around the titans.
timeline.quote: A tripartite glyph a hundred feet wide appeared on the floor of the valley in fierce green fire.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The leylines go taut and hold the titans, who shriek and shake the earth, but the spell absorbs all of Zendikar's mana.
timeline.quote: But then the leylines snapped taut.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The titans distort, the sky becomes the titans, and it begins raining Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: And then it began raining Eldrazi.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Cracks spread through the titans as the glyph erodes them, but Zendikar breaks faster and floating landmasses begin to fall.
timeline.quote: The titans, finally, were beginning to break.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's shoulder, sending the mana of all Zendikar through her, and Chandra ignites the leylines.
timeline.quote: The leylines themselves caught fire

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: The titans are destroyed in a blinding blast, and Chandra collapses.
timeline.quote: The world flashed with a roar of apocalyptic orange, then went blinding white.

citation.text: "Zendikar's Last Stand" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: With the help of the Gatewatch's four founders, the titans Ulamog and Kozilek are destroyed near Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the titans Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed near the city of Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
